turns.prompt: What are the main tutor pain points in the blueprint, by scenario?

replies.text:
**The primary tutor pain points documented in the service blueprint center on disjointed external tooling, high administrative burden around reflections and hours, and session-start friction with software and student routing.**

I queried 6 scenarios across the `Pre-session`, `In-session`, and `Post-session` `phases` in `uno-blueprint` just now, so these findings reflect the current-state service journey.

---

### `Phase`: Pre-session

* **`Scenario`: Call-off Request**
  * **High-volume and short-notice call-offs:** In spring 2026, call-offs ran between 300–640 per month, with roughly 1 in 5 filed under 12 hours before session start ([`Pre-session` › `Call-off Request` › `Under 12 hours` — `Regular Tutor` × `Initial need`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180103)).
  * **Opaque policy thresholds:** The attendance and call-off policy documentation in Notion is an empty shell, leaving escalation and excused/unexcused thresholds living solely in code ([`Pre-session` › `Call-off Request` › `Under 12 hours` — `Support Actions` × `Supervisor review (pending/excuse)`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180509)).

* **`Scenario`: Fill-in Request**
  * **Manual coverage chasing:** While open slots auto-populate in the Fill-In tab within a 72-hour window ([`Pre-session` › `Fill-in Request` › `Slot gets covered` — `Regular Tutor` × `Tutor browses Fill-In tab`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000150203)), urgent or hard-to-fill vacancies require supervisors to manually push outreach into Slack ([`Pre-session` › `Fill-in Request` › `Slot gets covered` — `Front Stage Actions` × `Tutor browses Fill-In tab`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000150204)).

---

### `Phase`: In-session

* **`Scenario`: Before Students Join**
  * **Manual Zoom room setup:** The `Lead Tutor` must join early, manually construct breakout rooms using a training calculator, grant co-host rights to regular tutors, and initiate recording ([`In-session` › `Before Students Join` › `Setup goes to plan` — `Lead Tutor` × `Prepare breakout rooms`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180402)).
  * **Coordination blindness:** Neither the tutor team nor classroom teachers can view the other’s preparation checklist, creating parallel tracks where hardware/network readiness and app roster orders are confirmed blindly ([`In-session` › `Before Students Join` › `Setup goes to plan` — `Teacher` × `Review room order`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180501)).

* **`Scenario`: Student Just Joined**
  * **Unassigned third-party coursework:** A top documented failure mode is students arriving to the session without logins or without work assigned in their math software (MATHia, IXL, i-Ready), forcing tutors to flag teachers immediately ([`In-session` › `Student Just Joined` › `Full room, on time` — `Regular Tutor` × `Share screen and log in`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b2000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000042)).
  * **Nickname and late-joiner triage:** `Lead Tutor`s must manually cross-check and rename students who join Zoom under nicknames to match rosters, and ping tutors over Zoom chat to retrieve stranded late joiners from the main room ([`In-session` › `Student Just Joined` › `Full room, on time` — `Lead Tutor` × `Students join`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000190102) and [`Raise hand for help`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000190302)).
  * **Rigid no-show escalations:** In low turnout situations, tutors cannot dismiss a room on their own; the `Lead Tutor` must wait 10 minutes and tag four supervisors in the school Slack channel to decide whether to end or repurpose the session ([`In-session` › `Student Just Joined` › `Few or none by 10 min` — `Lead Tutor` × `Wait 10 minutes`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b2000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000031) and [`Post in school Slack channel`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b2000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000032)).

* **`Scenario`: Help Request**
  * **Fragmented support routing:** Tutors must balance a multi-destination routing table (leads for room issues, school Slack for classroom issues, tech Slack for app issues), while teachers still escalate in-session issues by email to `tutors@tutors.plus` because a dedicated service desk tool is not yet selected ([`In-session` › `Help Request` › `Routed out` — `Regular Tutor` × `Resolve issue`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000033) and [`Teacher` × `Escalate unresolved issues`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000037)).

---

### `Phase`: Post-session

* **`Scenario`: Session Reflection**
  * **Form fatigue and deferred submissions:** Tutors spend 10–15 minutes completing reflections after every session without system prompts or automated triggers, leading back-to-back tutors to defer filing ([`Post-session` › `Session Reflection` › `Filed in one sitting` — `Regular Tutor` × `Open the form`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=c3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101) and [`Submit`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=c3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000151)).
  * **Ungated self-growth evaluations:** Tutors are required to rate themselves and pick growth areas after *every single session* because the form lacks cadence gating ([`Post-session` › `Session Reflection` › `Filed in one sitting` — `Regular Tutor` × `Self Reflection`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=c3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000141)).
  * **Low qualitative engagement:** Approximately 80% of free-text reflection notes are submitted empty ([`Post-session` › `Reporting an Issue` › `Standard` — `Front Stage Touchpoints` × `Reach out`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b5000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000031)).
  * **Context-free escalations:** Checking the escalation box in the reflection posts only the tutor name, date, and text box to supervisor Slack—with no backlink to the reflection itself ([`Post-session` › `Session Reflection` › `Filed in one sitting` — `Front Stage Actions` × `Submit`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=c3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000152)).

* **`Scenario`: Reporting Hours**
  * **Disconnected payroll bridge:** Hours are self-reported in CMU Workday, completely detached from the PLUS App database. There are no automated reminders or cross-checks against session attendance records, meaning missed deadlines only surface when supervisors manually reconcile entries and chase tutors in Slack or email ([`Post-session` › `Reporting Hours` › `Deadline missed` — `Regular Tutor` × `Miss reporting deadline`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-0000001e1103) and [`Back Stage Actions` × `Supervisor follow-up`](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-0000001e1207)).

---

### 1. `Phase`: `Pre-session`

* **`Scenario`: `Call-off Request`**
  * **Volume and scheduling conflicts:** Academic commitments and job conflicts drive high tutor friction, resulting in 300–640 call-offs per month (spring 2026 data). Tutors must file call-offs through Toolkit with rigid reason codes: [`Pre-session` › `Call-off Request` › `Under 12 hours` — `Regular Tutor` × "Initial need"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180103).
  * **Lack of self-service swaps:** In the `live` service, tutors must vacate sessions outright into the fill-in pool rather than easily trading them. Direct schedule swapping remains an exploratory `proposed` prototype marked TBD: [`Pre-session` › `Call-off Request` › `Swap offered instead` — `Regular Tutor` × "Swaps into another session"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=5c963899-7f8a-410c-a23c-0dea01e99217).
  * **Urgent vacancy chasing:** When a call-off happens under 12 hours, supervisors must manually chase coverage for unfilled slots through Slack: [`Pre-session` › `Call-off Request` › `Under 12 hours` — `Front Stage Actions` × "Coverage via fill-in pool"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000180404).

---

### 2. `Phase`: `Onboarding`

* **`Scenario`: `Session Sign Up`**
  * **Hard onboarding gating:** Scheduling surfaces remain completely locked until a tutor finishes the final onboarding module, preventing advance sign-ups: [`Onboarding` › `Session Sign Up` › `No conflicts` — `Back Stage Touchpoints` × "Review scheduling"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-000000130208).
  * **Recurring slot collisions:** Tutors must balance fixed school session times against university class schedules; automated soft-conflict checking is currently a `proposed` prototype rather than a shipped feature: [`Onboarding` › `Session Sign Up` › `Soft-conflict gate` — `Regular Tutor` × "Sign up"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=27068c9b-76f0-4d2b-9988-f4f8b6dd6480).

---

### 3. `Phase`: `In-session`

* **`Scenario`: `Help Request`**
  * **Multi-channel routing cognitive load:** When an issue is not simple math or reading content, tutors inside Zoom breakout rooms cannot escalate in a single click. They must consult a multi-channel routing matrix (lead tutor for rosters, school Slack for classroom issues, tech channel for software issues): [`In-session` › `Help Request` › `Routed out` — `Regular Tutor` × "Resolve issue"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000033).
  * **Absence of dedicated in-session ticketing:** Technical and app issues must be triaged ad-hoc over Slack because a formal servicedesk tool is not yet deployed: [`In-session` › `Help Request` › `Routed out` — `Support Actions` × "Resolve issue"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=b3000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000036).
  * **Classroom vs. breakout disconnect:** Teachers in the physical room have no visibility into Zoom breakout rooms to know if a student is absent or disconnected, requiring asynchronous alerts between the `Teacher` and `Regular Tutor`: [`In-session` › `Help Request` › `Resolved in the room` — `Teacher` × "Resolve issue"](https://plus-uno.netlify.app/blueprint/?cell=a0000000-0000-4000-8000-0000001b0401).

---

Tutor Pain Points Summary Table

| Phase | Scenario | Pain point |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Onboarding | Session Sign Up | Scheduling locked until onboarding is done |
| Pre-session | Call-off Request | Late call-offs and opaque policy |
| In-session | Help Request | Support routed by hand through Slack |
| Post-session | Session Reflection | Reflection fatigue after every session |
